dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: All things in moderation. Such is the natural way.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Rest first. After that, see that which lies before you with clear eyes before carefully determining your next steps.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Thus is the only path that leads to triumph.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I imagine you came well prepared for this adventure?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: In which case, we need only forge ahead with courage.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Should you encounter any danger that requires my aid, you need only ask.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Oh, there are quite a few books here, most of them folk tales from foreign lands...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Fascinating. Allow me to take a moment to peruse a few.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Should I discover any interesting stories, I shall be able to share them with the children in class.
